name: Heimdall
description: Heimdall is an application dashboard and launcher for organising links to websites, self-hosted services and web applications.

paths.name: Config
paths.description: Persistent Heimdall configuration and application data. Change the FAST pool name if your MOS appdata is stored elsewhere.

ports.name: HTTP Web UI
ports.description: Heimdall HTTP web interface. Port 8082 avoids conflicts with the MOS WebUI and can be used as the backend port for an external reverse proxy.

ports.name: HTTPS Web UI
ports.description: Optional Heimdall HTTPS web interface. Not normally required when TLS is terminated by a reverse proxy.

variables.name: User ID
variables.description: UID used by the container for persistent files. MOS commonly uses UID 500; change it if your appdata uses another owner.

variables.name: Group ID
variables.description: GID used by the container for persistent files. MOS commonly uses GID 500; change it if your appdata uses another group.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used by Heimdall. Change this to your local timezone, for example Europe/Madrid.

variables.name: Allow Internal Requests
variables.description: Allows Heimdall to make server-side requests to private/reserved IP addresses. Leave false for the safest default. Set true only when internal application lookups are required and Heimdall is appropriately protected.
